newsitem.title: USA: BroadBand files suit against Gen Instrument.
newsitem.headline: BroadBand files suit against Gen Instrument.

text.p: BroadBand Technologies Inc said on Tuesday it has filed a patent infringement suit in Federal District Court in Raleigh, North Carolina against General Instrument Corp.

BroadBand has charged that General Instrument infringes on a patent related to switched digital broadband technology that is used for digital telephony and data and video service, Broadband Technologies said.
BroadBand said it aims to block General Instrument from selling, using or providing switched digital broadband services.
General Instrument assistant general counsel Keith Zar said the company has not seen the suit and the company does not comment on pending litigation.
"We are very confident in our technology," Zar said.
